questions.q: Consider the following statements: Statement(I): The set of all solutions of the linear inequalities $3x+8<17$ and $2x+8\geq12$ are $x<3$ and $x\geq2$ respectively. Statement(II): The common set of solutions of linear inequalities $3x+8<17$ and $2x+8\geq12$ is (2,3). Which of the following is true?
options: Statement (I) is true but statement (II) is false
Statement (I) is false but statement (II) is true
questions.explanation: Solving gives x<3 and x≥2 (Statement I true), but the intersection is [2,3), not the open interval (2,3), so Statement II is false.

questions.q: The solution set of the inequation $\dfrac{x^2+6x-7}{|x+4|} < 0$ is ____
questions.explanation: Since $|x+4|>0$ for $x\ne-4$, the inequality reduces to $(x+7)(x-1)<0$, i.e. $-7<x<1$, excluding $x=-4$: $(-7,-4)\cup(-4,1)$.
